policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Midwestern State go furthest of the division's unbeaten sides Lees-McRae lost at home to Young Harris on the night Midwestern State won at Sul Ross State. Midwestern State have now played seventeen matches without defeat, winning thirteen and drawing four, and no other unbeaten side in the division has played as many.
